# MM-P2-L1-SB03 Maintenance manual - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Scope
This document defines routine maintenance for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) to ensure blast performance, operator safety, and component life. Use this procedure in conjunction with ECN-2026-033, ECN-2026-036, and SOP-P2-L1-01.

Tools
- Impact driver, hand tools set, inspection mirror, flashlight, magnetic tray.
- Torque wrench capable of reading 50 N·m for verification.
- Shop vacuum and replacement filter cartridge appropriate for cabinet dust outlet.

Procedure
- Isolate electrical supply and lock out per SOP-P2-L1-01 before any access. Verify zero energy state.
- Open access doors and perform visual inspection of liner, wheel, and media containment areas with flashlight and mirror.
- The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 50 N·m. Check each liner bolt for tightness and apply the specified torque with a calibrated torque wrench.
- Confirm shot delivery system clearances visually and remove build-up using non-sparking tools only.
- The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. Record runtime and replenish media to maintain minimum charge as described in ECN-2026-033.
- Inspect dust collector interface and replace filter cartridge if visibly loaded. Use shop vacuum to remove loose dust.
- Reassemble access panels, remove lockout, and perform a short functional run per SOP-P2-L1-01 to confirm normal operation.

Acceptance criteria
- Liner bolts are torqued to 50 N·m and show no signs of loosening after the functional run.
- Shot media level records indicate top-up performed at 33 hours intervals and media flow is consistent.
- No abnormal vibration, noise, or leakage observed during the functional run; cabinet performance meets baseline in ECN-2026-036.
- All actions are documented and signed per SOP-P2-L1-01.
